  body: (let bare : String := (tagPart1 text); (let bare3 : String := (tagPart2 bare); (Prelude::textAsciiLower bare3))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

}

definition{

definition{
  name: signKindLoop1,
  parameters: [items3 : (List String), state1 : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match items3
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons c rest4 => (let kind2 : Nat := (if (prim equal c "-" : Bool) then 1 else (if (prim equal c "+" : Bool) then 2 else (if ((not (prim less_than c "0" : Bool)) && (not (prim less_than "9" c : Bool))) then 3 else (if (Prelude::textIsWhitespace c) then 4 else 5)))); kind2)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items3
}

definition{
  name: signKind,
  parameters: [reading : String],
  result: Nat,
  body: (let kind : Nat := 0; (let state5 : Nat := (signKindLoop1 (Prelude::textChars reading) kind); state5)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: digitCountLoop1,
  parameters: [items3 : (List Nat), state1 : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match items3
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons byte rest4 => (if ((48 <=? byte) && (byte <=? 57)) then (let count2 : Nat := (if ((state1 + 1) <? 4294967296) then (state1 + 1) else 4294967295); (digitCountLoop1 rest4 count2)) else (digitCountLoop1 rest4 state1))),
  recursive_argument: items3
}

definition{
  name: digitCount,
  parameters: [reading : String],
  result: Nat,
  body: (let count : Nat := 0; (let state5 : Nat := (digitCountLoop1 (Prelude::textBytes reading) count); state5)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: numberedEnumerate1,
  parameters: [items3 : (List Room), index2 : Nat],
  result: (List TupleNatRoom),
  body: (match items3
    | List.nil => (nil TupleNatRoom)
    | List.cons item1 rest4 => (cons (record TupleNatRoom {item0 := index2, item1 := item1}) (numberedEnumerate1 rest4 (index2 + 1)))),
  recursive_argument: items3
}

definition{
  name: firstIsPart1,
  parameters: [name : String, rooms : (List Room)],
  result: (Option String),
  body: (match (prim index rooms 0 : (Option Room))
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [String])
    | Option.some room => (ctor Option.some [String] (project room name)))
}

definition{
  name: firstIs,
  parameters: [rooms : (List Room), name : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match (firstIsPart1 name rooms)
    | Option.none => (match (ctor Option.some [String] name)
      | Option.none => true
      | Option.some right3 => false)
    | Option.some left2 => (match (ctor Option.some [String] name)
      | Option.none => false
      | Option.some right3 => (prim equal left2 right3 : Bool)))
}

definition{

  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

definition{

}

theorem{
  name: decreases_occupiedTarget_0,
  parameters: [step : Step, occupied : Step, rest1 : Step],
  statement: ((step = (ctor Step.Either occupied rest1)) -> ((size_of_Step occupied) < (size_of_Step step))),
  proof: linear_arithmetic{definitions: [size_of_Step]},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: occupiedTarget,
  parameters: [step : Step],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match step
    | Step.Hold target => (ctor Option.some [Nat] target)
    | Step.Either occupied rest1 => (occupiedTarget occupied)
    | Step.Sequence value2 => (ctor Option.none [Nat])),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  termination: {evidence: [decreases_occupiedTarget_0], measure: (size_of_Step step)}
}

definition{
  name: isSequence,
  parameters: [step : Step],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match step
    | Step.Hold value1 => false
    | Step.Either value2 rest3 => false
    | Step.Sequence value4 => true)
}

definition{
  name: labelsInsert1,
  parameters: [items2 : (List String), item3 : String],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items2
    | List.nil => (cons item3 (nil String))
    | List.cons head4 rest5 => (if (prim equal item3 head4 : Bool) then (cons head4 rest5) else (if (prim less_than item3 head4 : Bool) then (cons item3 (cons head4 rest5)) else (cons head4 (labelsInsert1 rest5 item3))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items2
}

definition{
  name: labelsLoop2,
  parameters: [items7 : (List Phase), state1 : (List String)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items7
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons phase rest8 => (let out6 : (List String) := (labelsInsert1 state1 (field_Phase_label phase)); (labelsLoop2 rest8 out6))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items7
}

definition{
  name: labels,
  parameters: [phases : (List Phase)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (let out : (List String) := (nil String); (let state9 : (List String) := (labelsLoop2 phases out); state9)),

}

definition{
  name: heldTargetsPart1,
  parameters: [phase : Phase],
  result: Nat,

    | Option.none => 0
    | Option.some value2 => value2),

definition{
  name: heldTargetsInsert2,
  parameters: [items3 : (List TupleStringNat), item4 : TupleStringNat],
  result: (List TupleStringNat),
  body: (match items3
    | List.nil => (cons item4 (nil TupleStringNat))
    | List.cons head5 rest6 => (if (prim equal (project item4 item0) (project head5 item0) : Bool) then (cons item4 rest6) else (if (prim less_than (project item4 item0) (project head5 item0) : Bool) then (cons item4 (cons head5 rest6)) else (cons head5 (heldTargetsInsert2 rest6 item4))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items3
}

definition{
  name: heldTargetsLoop3,
  parameters: [items8 : (List Phase), state1 : (List TupleStringNat)],
  result: (List TupleStringNat),
  body: (match items8
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons phase rest9 => (let out7 : (List TupleStringNat) := (heldTargetsInsert2 state1 (record TupleStringNat {item0 := (field_Phase_label phase), item1 := (heldTargetsPart1 phase)})); (heldTargetsLoop3 rest9 out7))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items8
}

definition{

}

definition{

definition{
  name: numberedLoop3,
  parameters: [items9 : (List TupleNatRoom), state5 : (List String)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items9
    | List.nil => state5
    | List.cons pair6 rest10 => (let i : Nat := (project pair6 item0); (let room : Room := (project pair6 item1); (let out8 : (List String) := (prim append state5 (cons (prim join (cons (numberedPart2 i) (cons ":" (cons (project room name) (nil String)))) "" : String) (nil String)) : (List String)); (numberedLoop3 rest10 out8))))),
  axioms: [propext],
  recursive_argument: items9
}

definition{

definition{
  name: describe,
  parameters: [phase : Phase],
  result: String,
  body: (let target : Nat := (describePart1 phase); (let sequence : Bool := (isSequence (field_Phase_step phase)); (prim join (cons (field_Phase_label phase) (cons ": " (cons (Prelude::natDecimal target) (cons (heldUnit) (cons " (sequence: " (cons (if sequence then "true" else "false") (cons ")" (nil String)))))))) "" : String))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
